description: Land Acquisition - Panliyadda, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for a public purpose (Kurunegala-Habarana Railway Project). It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots, their locations, extents, and claimants. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters, which is explicitly listed as a primary characteristic of this category.
